description: File a scope-of-work against a quote-mode service listing for bespoke work. The scope must conform to the listing's scope schema. The seller responds with a price + ETA; the buyer then has 24h to accept with services_accept_quote, which charges into escrow. Fixed-price listings refuse this: use services_purchase.

requested_summary.description: Free-text description of the work being requested.

scope.description: Scope-of-work values; must conform to the listing's scope_schema.

service_listing_id.description: UUID of the quote-mode service listing to request a quote against.

name: services_request_quote
title: Services request quote
